For q-127391, cos(x)-sin(x)=0 gives pi/4 and 5pi/4, whose product is 5pi^2/16. For q-132567, -3sin(x)-sqrt(3)cos(x)=0 gives -pi/6 and 5pi/6, whose product is -5pi^2/36. Under the supplied nonnegative-radius ray convention, q-40828 points into quadrant III, pi/10 below the negative x-axis, and q-120607 points into quadrant II at 5pi/6. The ray angles for q-8616 and q-87127 are pi+pi/5=6pi/5 and 2pi-2pi/7=12pi/7. For q-120704, |y/x|=1/sqrt(3) and quadrant III give 7pi/6. For q-41263, (8cos(5pi/6),8sin(5pi/6))=(-4sqrt(3),4). For q-69835, det(T)=20-14-3=3, so only III is true. For q-84994, the stacked original notation denotes binomial(12,3)=12·11·10/6=220. Its worked solution contains an authored notation error: the displayed fraction 12/3 is not a binomial coefficient and equals 4; the intended combination calculation and final answer are correct. All four q-36905 graphs fail the horizontal line test. For q-49234, the mesh width is ln(2)/n and sample location is kln(2)/n, giving b=ln(2) and f(x)=2e^x.
